8249.title: Sidebar percentages omit a visible consumption label
8249.rootCauseOneLine: UsageWindow labels consumed quota in aria-label but paints only a bare percentage, with no shared visible legend.
8249.proposedFix: Show one Quota used label above active measured windows; preserve per-window accessible names and reset behavior.
8249.caveats: Synthetic component and story fixtures, not live accounts. Repeated by the same agent in a clean checkout. Complete reproduction test is inline per reports repository policy.
